templates.MCU-2: frameless 50/50: two MCU-F busts, one per third, the thing between them soft (rack target)

shots.what: The suite: the crane truck passes, every glass shivers but his.
His two fingers nudge the glass one pixel true.
MAS frameless, left third; the suite steps down behind him to the laptop glow; the flash-print to blueprint rides the last beat.
THE WORD: the grid draws itself; HOW TO FIRE A CEO WHO OWNS NOTHING. stamps.
THE DIAGRAM: nine chairs; DIRE, NOVIHS, DRUH walk off; LEFT EARLIER IN 2023; THESE FOUR VOTE.
The structure, plan view: a whole-pixel PAN down one oversize sheet, NONPROFIT → CONTROLS → COMPANY, the key ring outside the fence.
shots.build: kit param (sheet taller than the frame)

shots.what: Cut-in: the CEO box, EQUITY: 0 (HIS TESTIMONY); the blueprint moth opens its wings (linework redrawn 2x, 1 px lines).
THE PLAN: four walkers tick 1 · 2 · 3 in stride and stop at 4.
The walkers at 2x: NELEH "Step four." / MADA "Good question." (a GFX pair: one Q+A in one frame).
The blank line: the chalk squeaks and snaps.
The corner curls, neon bleeds through; the sheet tears on the line of step 4.
His hand on the trackpad; JOIN; click.
His laptop: the five-tile grid connects; four vote icons already flipped (Wi-Fi 1 bar egg).
NELEH name card rides the live grid.
MAS frameless; the suite down to the Strip neon + laptop glow; he reads the icons, one pupil step per tile; HOLD 1 beat.
The app's active-speaker view (automatic, never his click) pins ALYI: his mouth moves, no sound reaches Mas; the box over his tile types … and stops.
The 1993-style dialog pops up over his tile: OK · Cancel (Cancel live).
The eyes strip: his pupils move one pixel toward the dialog.
The unlit arrow steps in from the board tiles, one tile a beat.
MAS, still: the laptop glow only; nothing on him moves while the arrow (O.S.) settles on Cancel.
Close on the dialog: the arrow clicks Cancel on the downbeat. D6 DROP-OUT starts here.

MAS full frame, silent (the Strip neon); HOLD 2 beats; +1 FIRING on beat 3.
The phone buzzes, the room sound returns; [super]×3 lights; the mic chip still lit; his thumb taps the middle one at once.
MAS frameless (neon): "super." into the still-open mic. No music.
The grid as his screen shows it: four held faces (a listener's hold); the control bar's mic still lit.
The suite: the truck passes, every glass shivers; his does not.
The candor quote card.
His greyed tile, still falling, becomes the render front.
F1.2 TPOOL door, EARLY-WEB16, (REPORTED).
The frosted glass; the dither settles into wood grain.
He carves mark 3, brushes the shavings, thumb on mark 3 only. V.O. "i don't keep score." (bar 2).
Mas + the Orb: its iris counts 1, 2, 3 and stops on his thumb.
His phone, full-bleed: the post types in source casing, 9:32 PM PT.
The Senate wallet, HEALTH INSURANCE; a moth flies out.
MAS frameless; the room down to the cyan key + rack LEDs; V.O. "the meeting ended early." on the hoodie shadow.
The Orb's iris, full frame, lifts from the desk to his face; toast rewinding…; WHIP (right→left) into pass one.
The board's grid on a laptop, bezel: the call goes on; his "super." out of the small speaker (no portrait).
NELEH at her own desk (her tile's world, full frame): she turns a page and doesn't look up. The catch lands on a face.
Toast GERG MOCKBRAN has left.; his post "…I quit." green-lit.
Closer on the laptop: BUKAJ has left.; keycaps rain across the tiles.
RIMA in her hard spotlight, smoothing her jacket; RIMA TAMURI name card rides.
The call's two-up (bezel): RIMA "I'll hold it together." in her tile, NELEH listening in hers.
NELEH (her desk): "For how long?"
RIMA (pleasant): "We'll share more soon."
The two-up: NELEH, one brow up.
The bullpen all-hands: one hand up in the tiled crowd; "Is this a coup?" (box with a tail).
ALYI frameless in the doorway, the jamb and leaf cutting him: "You can call it this way" [V]. No move.
The crowd: the one hand is still up (the listener).
ALYI steps back into the dark of the doorway, one whole-pixel step a time, until the frame has all of him; the empty doorway holds 1 beat.

shots.what: NOV 18: a heart, ten, hundreds pour over the grid.
Screen macro (integer 2x of the screen's own pixels, the bezel corner kept in frame: the world's view): the one blue heart lands on Mada's spinner and spins with it.
His post "…eulogy" scrolls across the hearts.
Boardroom, night: NELEH (marker) + MADA (spinner), ALYI a reflection in the window between them; every phone buzzes.
NELEH frameless, left third, facing right (flipped): "The bylaws allow it. Footnote three."
Over NELEH's shoulder onto the window: ALYI's reflection "Step four… will reveal itself."
NELEH: "When?" (Mada unmoved, the reflection between them).
ALYI's reflection close in the dark glass, the Valley's lights through him: "The company will tell us."
NELEH listening, one brow up.
Overhead on the walnut: every phone buzzes harder and walks toward the edge, one held step a beat.
NELEH: "The company is calling us."
ALYI's reflection between them: "That is the company telling us." It flickers for two frames and steadies; the black tile never moves.
shots.rule: was [P] box + 2S merged (-30 f: the flicker rides the line's tail)

shots.what: NELEH looks down at the blank line; the boardroom steps down behind her. HOLD 1 beat. Her real face.
Her hand uncaps the marker and writes ? on the blank line.
The whole table: the speakerphone dials four tones. CUT on the first ring.
Lighthouse: the phone with the little throne rings. Rail (REPORTED).
MARIO, the lamp turning in the window behind: "I've written up some thoughts."
The lighthouse: ADELINA crosses and takes the phone out of his hand; her name card rides.
ADELINA, into the phone: "In plain English: no."
Click. The throne falls off the handset.
MARIO answers the second phone; the rent meters spin SHARP in the window behind (record text never goes soft): "Hi. Yes. We're very worried. How much?"
The lobby security-camera tile, bezel, grainy: a figure in a GUEST lanyard; his post upside-down in the corner.
Boardroom, Nov 19: the spotlight swings off Rima's empty chair onto TTEMME.
TTEMME name card rides the wide.
TTEMME (headset, hourglass; his stream chat scrolling up the frame edge): "Chat. I'm the CEO now."
He sets the hourglass down and flips it: three drawings.
Desk level: the hourglass big in the foreground, sand falling; TTEMME above it watching: "Chat… for how long?"

shots.what: NELEH + MADA: the wall steps to slate; a door appears and opens. Hard cut to the door (no whip: her real line starts 6 f into 27.33).
TASYA in the new doorway, slate light, the sign pointing out: "a new advanced AI research team" [V]. No move.
NELEH + MADA look down at the blueprint (the listeners).
Overhead: step 4 blank but for her ?. NELEH (O.S.): "Step four?"
MADA, the spinner turning: "Good question." Pass one ends on his face.
WHAT THEY DIDN'T KNOW.
The home shot: the glass from above, its water line flat. Rail · HIS SIDE.
Mas + the Orb, the lanyard square by the glass; his hand on the phone. V.O. "i put the phone down."
The matching frame: face-down, too still, keynote piano.
Hard cut: the same frame, face-up; Rima's post [V]; eight hearts on the beat.
The Orb's iris steps off the phone onto the GUEST lanyard (beat 3) and stays.
The iris full frame, holding on the lanyard. V.O. "the badge was a joke." HOLD 1 beat.
MAS aloud, to the Orb: "mostly." (look toward it); RACK to the Orb soft-then-sharp behind his shoulder; it doesn't move. Cut on the downbeat.
The counter rolls 505 · 650 · 700 · 745 / 770; clunk.
The employee letter quote card.
The signature list stops 2 beats on ALYI (REPORTED).
The iris: to the name, to Alyi's thumbnail, back. Chime. (The Orb's beat; no Mas tell.)
DELIVERY: the rack slot ejects the check tray across the desk.
GERG's video tile opens on the monitor, big enough to act in: "One sec. Compiling."
MAS, facing his monitor: "what are you building?"
GERG: "The company. Again. Just in case."
QUIET BEAT: MAS; the room falls away to the monitor's green + his cyan; he watches Gerg type.
Gerg's tile fills the frame; he glances up into his camera, at Mas.
MAS looks back (the look swaps from the tile to the lens).
The whole back wall: V.O. "gerg never waits to be asked."; on "asked" the slate door steps up; TASYA (O.S.) "Everyone is welcome."
MAS at once, not turning: "leave it open." The slate door soft behind him; after the line, RACK to the door.
AVALANCHE phrase 1: the board's grid on the monitor; one tile appears, another; hundreds begin to fall.
MAS watching, blank; each landing steps the ROOM's light (never his face).

shots.what: The stack presses on the board's row.
Phrase 2: ALYI's tile shoved sideways; resisting one beat, it fills half the frame; it slides off.
NELEH's tile follows, footnotes scattering: "Has anyone read the char—"
Phrase 3: the Quiet Vote's tile pushed out without a sound; the faces keep coming.
The glass on the desk, from above, in the monitor's flicker: its water line flat while the screen shakes.

Phrase 4: MADA's tile wedged in the gap; every tile presses; he doesn't move; the half-frame hold (his real face).
MADA / LAST FIRER STANDING rides the tile wall.
Hold: 745 faces press; the spinner turns; the phrase ends.

MAS left in his window, ALYI right in the door-cut window; ALYI's post [V]; three hearts rise out of Mas's window and cross the gap; Alyi looks up; HOLD 2 beats; the IOU flutters. The act's one deliberate box: two men in two boxes.
The bullpen: every desk boxed, coats on, TASYA mid-floor: "We are below them," the floor steps to slate from her feet.
Low angle, the bullpen ceiling: "above them," (O.S.) the ceiling steps to slate in 3 held palette steps.
TASYA delighted: "around them." The walls go slate behind her.
MAS at his desk looking down at the floor (the look-down swap): "hi."
His eyeline: the slate floor from above, his shoe tips at the top edge. TASYA (O.S., from the floor): "Hello."

The door bangs open: TERB, extinguisher like a briefcase, the helmet appears.
TERB card, full freeze; Mas walks past in colour and pulls the pin.

TERB, the fires soft behind: "Which room is on fire?"
The room looks around at the fires as if for the first time. TERB: "…Ah."

Over Mas's shoulder (silhouette, the fires' rim) onto MADA: "Good question." HOLD 1 beat.
MAS, near-front, eyes toward Mada, fires soft behind: HOLD 1 beat; "good question." (one beat late).
HOLD 1 BAR: two still men; the spinner stops; the nod; Terb's hand stamps the term sheet, hands it to both.
His phone lights green: GERG's post [V]; keycaps pop.
MAS reading it; his face doesn't change.
The hourglass: the last grain; TTEMME's post [V]; only the glass shatters; the sand holds its shape one beat, falls.
The lobby from low: the wall sign lights up over us, DAYS SINCE SOMEONE TRIED TO FIRE MAS: 0; Mas small at the reception desk.
A maintenance hand sets a box of spare 0 plates under the sign.
Over Mas's shoulder (tungsten rim) onto the lobby: the 1993 dialog, Cancel greys 3 steps, the arrow bonks.
